subject: AW: Korro AI <> Encord | Next steps
text:
Hi Kamil,

I honestly cannot say how many embeddings & metrics we want to compute per month. However, I also have to admit that I am not a big fan of intransparent pricing as this always feels a bit off for a SAAS service. I do understand tiers or pay as you go models, but I would expect that you can tell me something along the lines:

on our “XYZ tier” you pay X$ per user per month and Y$ per GB storage and Z$ per compute unit where compute is …

As we mentioned we can for now assume an overall raw data size of 15-20TB. Here we can distinguish between custom cloud storage or Encord provided storage. As for users, I would have expected that my team can access the platform and it’s not per seat, but if so, please share the pricing structure.

I’ll do my best to make Thursday work, but I there’s a chance I might need to cancel. In any case, it would be great to get some indication of cost before.

Best regards,

subject: Re: Support with Technical Questions
text:
Hi Seif,

Please see below for our questions, some technical and some not.

   -
   https://docs.encord.com/platform-documentation/General/annotate-data-integrations
   seems to indicate that just audio isn't supported as a data type, is this
   correct?
   - Are there data storage limits in Encord?
   - We need to import fairly complicated .json metadata (it is quite
   nested and it varies quite a bit depending on the sample, but there are
   standard schemas for them). We're having trouble figuring out where to go
   in order to begin this process to be able to include this metadata in
   Encord. We were able to get the custom metadata in, but it is prompting us
   to upgrade to Encord Index in order to use the metadata at all in Encord?
   An example of data we might want to look at is a line plot, we can finesse
   our proprietary format into Encord's json format without loss of
   information, but we would like to be able to plot these things in the
   annotator tool as needed.
   - Can we use the SDK to retroactively filter and clean data via SQL
   query or similar?
   - Is it possible to edit metadata through the UI and not through the
   SDK?
   - Is it possible for annotators and reviewers to see metadata on
   non-DICOM files?
   - Is it possible for reviewers to edit file metadata?

Thanks,
Thomas

   - 11 sample images

      over time

Let me know if you have any follow up questions for us!

Best,
Brad
